description: Register someone for an event. They get the event's confirmation email with their QR ticket unless the organiser switched it off, so confirm the person and the event with the user first. Registering doesn't subscribe them to marketing unless marketingOptIn is true because they asked.

apiKey.description: Send16 API key (overrides SEND16_API_KEY env var)

marketingOptIn.description: Only when the person asked to hear about future events

name: register_for_event
title: Register someone for an event
